name: TokenSelect
description: A custom dropdown for selecting design tokens with color swatch previews. Supports all token categories from the design system (surface ramp, semantic surfaces, text, borders, brand, and action colors). Features keyboard navigation, type-ahead search, and portal-based dropdown rendering.
usage: Import `TokenSelect` and optionally `getTokensForCategory` from the design system.
Set `tokenCategory` to one of the predefined categories, or provide custom `options`.
Use `error` and `touched` props to display validation errors.
design: Use for selecting design system color tokens, not arbitrary colors.
Color swatches provide immediate visual feedback for token values.
Dropdown renders via portal to escape overflow containers.
Label should clearly describe what the token controls.
Type-ahead works for numeric surface ramp values (0-25).
accessibility: Full keyboard navigation: Arrow keys, Home/End, Enter/Space, Escape, Tab.
Type-ahead search for surface ramp indices.
Disabled state prevents interaction and is visually distinct.

props.name: id
props.description: Unique identifier for the select element.

props.name: label
props.description: Text label displayed above the select.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback fired when the value changes.

props.name: options
props.description: Custom token options. Overrides tokenCategory when provided. Each option has value, label, and cssVar.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message to display (enables error state).

props.name: helperText
props.description: Optional helper text shown below the select.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional class name for the container.

props.name: touched
props.description: Whether the field has been touched (used for error display).

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Callback fired when the select loses focus.

props.name: compact
props.description: Use compact sizing (smaller chip, reduced padding, smaller typography) for dense layouts like goodies sidebars.

types.name: TokenOption
types.definition: { value: string; label: string; cssVar: string; }

utilities.name: getTokensForCategory
utilities.description: Returns the token options for a given category. Useful for programmatic access to design tokens.
